dr_mp3 (dr_mp3.h), single-header public-domain/MIT-0 MP3 decoder by David
Reid (mackron), based on minimp3 (https://github.com/lieff/minimp3).
Upstream: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs (master branch, v0.7.4 at time
of vendoring, no version tag on the repo itself).

Used for MP3 import only (src/wav_io.cpp): NeoLooper has no MP3 export, and
MP3 carries no loop/root-note metadata NeoLooper cares about (unlike the
WAV/AIFF smpl-chunk path via libsndfile), so decoding is the only thing
needed from it.
